title: MARS - Hypertrophy Program
author: Aaron V.
desc: This is a Hypertrophy Training Program.

ex.note:
Try to get 15 Reps Exactly on First Set. 

For remainder of sets, keep the same weight and attempt to hit 12. 

2 - 2.5 minutes rest between sets.

Try to hit 10 reps exactly on top set with your weight of choice. 
Repeat for 2nd set. 
Keep same weight for 3rd set but try to hit at least 9. 
Drop weight by 20% for last set and hit 15 reps.

ss.note: 2 minute rest after superset of Tricep Pushdowns and Preacher Curls.

ex.note:
Hold Bottom for 2 Seconds. 

2-3 minute rest between sets.

Hold Top for 2 Seconds. 

Drop weight by 20% for last set and try to hit 15 reps. 

2 minute rest between sets.

Hold Top for 2 Seconds. 

Drop weight by 20% for last set and try to hit 15 reps even if that means doing half reps!

Rest for 2 minutes between sets.
Lighter Weight. Slow and controlled.

First 3 sets are with moderate - high intensity. 

Last set is slow and controlled to focus on the stretch and burn.

Same Weight for First 3 Sets. TRY to hit the same amount of reps for first 3 sets. 

On Last Set, Drop Weight by 20% and focus on the squeeze. Slow, Controlled, Intense. 

2-3 minutes between sets.

TRY to hit same weight & same amount of reps for first 3 sets. These first three sets are supposed to be HARD!

Drop Weight by 20% for last set & push for 12-15. Rest-Pause if needed to hit rep goal.
Choose weight where you believe you will fail on 15th rep for top set. Use same weight for second set and try to hit 12.
Choose weight where you believe you’ll fail on the 12th rep for Top Set. Try to hit 10 for second set.
Hold Top for 2 Seconds!
Hold Top for 2 Seconds!
Seated or Standing is okay.
GO SUPER LIGHT HERE! Hold Bottom position for 2 seconds and squeeze those quads!
Barbell or Machine is okay.

Machine or Cable is fine. 

Increase weight by 20% for last set and try to hit 10.

ss.note: Machine or Dumbbells okay. 3 minute rest between supersets.

ex.note: Choose weight where you can squeeze the chest at the top and get a deep stretch. Lower weight by 20% for last set!
Go Lighter Here and Focus on Chest Tension. Do not fully lock out arms. Slow and controlled and squeeze near top of movement.
